## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or a specific industrial monitoring requirement?
*E.g., I'm always frustrated when trying to analyze bearing ball pass frequencies for non-standard bearing geometries.*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen:
- Algorithm / DSP additions (e.g. envelope analysis, cepstrum, order tracking)
- Telemetry & protocol changes
- UI / visualization features (new plots, 3D waterfall, alarms)
- Export formats (HDF5, MQTT, OPC-UA)

## Alternative Approaches
A description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Target Architecture & Compatibility
- [ ] C++ Core DSP Engine
- [ ] Python Telemetry & Signal Processing
- [ ] PySide6 / PyQtGraph Industrial Dashboard
- [ ] Storage & Export Pipeline

## Additional Context / Standards References
Add any other context, technical references, or vibration standards (e.g., ISO 10816-3, ISO 20816, VDI 3834).
